snippet.title: Escape The Cradle trailer
snippet.description:
I've been making a sfw incremental game where you recover hp between runs by headpatting a foxgirl.

You can try the demo here
https://azurezero.itch.io/escape-the-cradle

Or wishlist here
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3938850/Escape_The_Cradle/
